## fd24427a4ff0

Audited source SHA-256:
`32e7dad57414152ed7e72c677b6175f97e00a7b5c49406e43f3447e396a91090`.
The strict battery completed with 5 green and 7 failed stages: lint, selfcheck,
defect_lint, profile_floor, semantic_gate, override and authority_sync. Summary:
`checks/audit/fd24427a4ff0-battery/checks/fd24427a4ff0_audit_battery_summary.json`.

### AUD-FD244-01 — reproduced validator rejection of canonical data (critical)

`self_check` rejects canonical visible example 1 with
`trapezoid top and bottom widths differ`. Its first color-8 component has row
widths `[11,13,15,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,17,15,13,11,9]`, which is lawful under
the canonical clipped-Manhattan-diamond rule but violates the generator's
narrower equal-edge model. Both the self-check and profile-floor stages reproduce
the rejection. Evidence:
`checks/audit/audit_probe.json`,
`checks/audit/fd24427a4ff0-battery/checks/fd24427a4ff0_audit_selfcheck.log`, and
`checks/audit/fd24427a4ff0-battery/checks/fd24427a4ff0_audit_profile_floor.log`.

**Impact:** a validator intended to define lawful task inputs excludes an
actual canonical input, so coverage and mutation claims are unsound for the full
authority domain. No repair was made.

### AUD-FD244-02 — reproduced ignored exact axes (important)

For fixed seed/sample, valid extremes of `body_h` (2 versus 8), `top_w` (3
versus 9), `position_bias` (`center` versus `top_left`) and `body_w_delta` (1
versus 3) all produce byte-identical grids. The source draws these values from a
raw RNG rather than keyed `gen_ctx` axes; the override gate records missing
provenance and widespread mismatches. Float/negative scalar calls are also
accepted, and all five helpful textures are reported dead. Evidence:
`checks/audit/audit_probe.json`,
`checks/audit/fd24427a4ff0-battery/checks/fd24427a4ff0_audit_override.log`, and
`checks/audit/fd24427a4ff0-battery/checks/fd24427a4ff0_audit_defect_lint.log`.

**Impact:** curriculum controls named in `AXES` cannot be relied on to construct
or replay the requested shape family. No repair was made.

### AUD-FD244-03 — reproduced active authority text divergence (important)

The authority-sync stage finds two active selected authorities in different
exact/comment-stripped groups, although execution parity passes. The diagnostic
specifically says selected `target_code` should match canonical
`program_solution` while preserving archival `raw_code`. Evidence:
`checks/audit/fd24427a4ff0-battery/checks/fd24427a4ff0_audit_authority_sync.log`.

**Impact:** behavior currently agrees, but source identity and future edits are
not anchored to one active text. No repair was made.
